page.layout: One page: the e-rara.ch digitiser's cover sheet, with logo at top right, title block centred, and licence text in the lower half.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. It shows the e-rara.ch logo, the title "Disputationis philosophicae, quae exhibet compendium ontosophiae, pars altera", author "Leemann, Samuel", "Bernae, 1699", the holding library, a persistent link, usage terms in German, English, French and Italian, and the Visual Library mark. None of this is transcribed, as it is not printed text of the book.
